test_initialize_scenario: test that a scenario initializes correctly with apps populated from HuggingFace demo universes
test_add_event_success: test adding user agent and calendar events to a scenario and verify event count
test_edit_event_success: test editing an existing calendar event to change its action to send_message_to_user
test_delete_event_removes_hint: test that deleting an event from a scenario also removes its associated hint
test_failure_probability: test that tool failure probability is correctly applied to all tools in a scenario
